messages:
Alex: Quick flag 7/v1/generate7 API ref is inconsistent. Top schema uses 'input' (which matches backend), but examples & SDK snippets still show 'prompt'. Tests caught it in docs CI. Can someone take ownership of the cleanup?

Maria: I can. Do we standardize on 'input' then update all snippets, or keep 'prompt' for backwards compatibility?

Alex: Backend prefers 'input'. Let's standardize on that and add a short migration note for 'prompt' -> 'input'. Also the streaming section needs a clearer SSE example showing event names and per-event JSON; current block is ambiguous.

Sam: FYI docs CI failed with jsonschema: 
```
ValidationError: additionalProperties 'prompt' not allowed in request body for /v1/generate
```
So we should stop shipping 'prompt' examples.

Ken: Also call out the token param rename we discussed — 'max_new_tokens' -> 'max_tokens' — in the migration note. Customers updating payloads will appreciate seeing both changes together.

Maria: Plan: 1) update the API ref request schema to emphasize 'input' as canonical, 2) replace examples (curl, python, node) to use 'input', 3) add a Migration Notes subsection listing 'prompt' -> 'input' and 'max_new_tokens' -> 'max_tokens' with tiny examples, 4) replace the streaming snippet with an explicit SSE example. Ill open a branch docs/generate-input-migration.

Lindsey: When you update examples, please point the "See also" runnable snippets link to github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples#generate (that's our canonical sample repo). Also update the "code samples" table to list which SDK versions the snippet corresponds to.

Maria: Draft for streaming SSE (will polish in PR):
```
# curl SSE example
curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"input":"hello","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# client receives lines like:
event: chunk
data: {"delta":"Hello"}
event: chunk
data: {"delta":" world"}
event: done
data: {"id":"resp_123","status":"complete"}
```

Sam: Small CI note: run 'make docs-validate' locally after the change. We saw jsonschema differences between contributor envs and CI, so pinning validator version in the dev container helps.

Docs-bot: linked issue #2099 -> docs PR 5010 opened by Maria with label 'docs:needs-review'

Maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5010 1 files changed (api-reference/generate.md + examples/snippets). Reviewers: @alex, @ken, @lindsey. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Alex: Thanks. I'll do a pass tomorrow AM. Please include a one-line changelog entry under "Compatibility" so customers see the break upfront. :thumbsup:
